name: thumbnail-skill
role: thumbnail rendering (deterministic execution); not decision, not selection, not design
description: Renders a typed ThumbnailDocument (canvas + still-image/video-frame assets + positioned image/text elements) into a validated PNG/JPEG with provenance. Never decides what a thumbnail should show: it ranks candidate frames and moves text clear of faces only from facts measured elsewhere (detection-skill faces, caller frame measures) by stated formulas, and the caller decides. No face detection or pixel analysis of its own, no OCR, no title generation, no click-through prediction, no A/B or publish decisions. Not an AI agent.

tools.description: Validate a ThumbnailDocument (canvas + assets + elements) structurally. Touches no file system, no font, no ffmpeg-skill; renders nothing.

Render a typed ThumbnailDocument (still image and/or an explicit video frame, positioned image and text elements) into a validated PNG/JPEG artifact with provenance. Never decides what to show: frame timestamps, layout, text and fonts are exactly what the caller specified.
tools.idempotency_hint: same document + same asset/font content + same skill/engine version reuses the cached artifact
side_effects: writes a reuse cache entry under the workspace

tools.description: Extract exactly the video frame at a caller-given timestamp as a PNG/JPEG. No scene detection, no scoring, no 'best frame' search: one timestamp in, one frame out.
tools.idempotency_hint: same source content + same timestamp + same skill/engine version reuses the cached artifact
side_effects: writes a reuse cache entry under the workspace

tools.description: Render one thumbnail per row of a table (a CSV file or inline rows) and per platform target, from one ThumbnailDocument template per target with {{column}} placeholders. Named text elements are shrunk to fit a caller-given box, down to a stated minimum font size, never cut or wrapped; a row that does not fit is refused. Every row is checked before anything is written; each file then goes through thumbnail/render, with its output check and its output.preset check.

input.targets: [{preset, document: ThumbnailDocument template, text_fit?: {element_id: {max_width, max_height?, min_font_size}}}]

output.items: [{row, preset, output, format, width, height, size, sha256, reused, preset_check, fitted}]

tools.idempotency_hint: each file is a thumbnail/render and is reused from its cache the same way
side_effects: writes one output file per row and target
writes reuse cache entries under the workspace

tools.description: Render a ThumbnailDocument as thumbnail/render does and also write every composed layer (background, each image, each text background band, each text) as a PNG with alpha, cropped to its visible pixels, with a manifest (order, position, size) for a designer to rebuild it (CLI: thumbnail render --layers DIR). The tool rebuilds the image from the layer files on disk by the manifest and refuses (VALIDATION_ERROR, layers_mismatch) unless it equals the thumbnail pixel for pixel.

output.layers: {directory, manifest, count, layers [{order, role, element_id, file, position, size, sha256}], verified}

side_effects: writes one PNG per layer and layers.json into layers.directory
writes a reuse cache entry under the workspace

tools.description: Write N documented variants of one thumbnail for a platform A/B test (CLI: thumbnail render --variants N). Variant k takes entry (k-1) mod n of each axis: the text element's layout, its palette, and the frame one image element shows; entry 0 of each axis is the document as given, so variant 1 is the original. Each variant is a thumbnail/render and is checked at phone size: its text height at phone_width px wide (default 320) and its contrast through qc-skill's text legibility. A variant below a minimum is reported (flagged), never dropped. Never picks a winner.

output.variants: [{variant, output, choices, description, small_size {status, ok, texts [{element_id, text_height_px_at_phone, contrast_ratio, findings}]}}]

tools.idempotency_hint: each variant is a thumbnail/render and is reused from its cache the same way
side_effects: writes one output file per variant
writes reuse cache entries under the workspace

tools.description: Rank the sampled frames of a detection-skill/detections@1 face document (detection faces --attributes) by a stated, weighted formula over measured facts: eyes open, frontal angle and face size from detection-skill, sharpness from the caller's frame measures or else detection-skill's face sharpness, exposure from the caller's frame measures. Frames whose main face has its eyes closed come after every frame where they are open. Every part and every missing part is listed. Detects nothing and reads no pixels; the ranking suggests and the caller decides.

output.ranking: [{rank, index, t, score, parts, missing, sources, eyes_closed, faces, main_face, main_face_box}]
output.asset: {kind: video_frame, path, timestamp} when video is given

tools.description: Move one text element of a ThumbnailDocument to the first candidate position (caller-given, or eight edge and corner positions) whose painted box stays on the canvas and clears every face box by a margin. Face boxes come from detection-skill and are mapped onto the canvas through the image element's crop, fit and position. Refused when no candidate is clear; the text is never placed over a face. Returns the updated document; renders nothing.

input.faces: [[x, y, w, h]] in frame_size pixels

output.placement: {chosen, position, align, text_box, face_boxes, margin, tried}

tools.description: Optional (ADR-12): generate one background image from a caller-written prompt and an explicit seed with a named, locally installed AI provider (FLUX.2 [klein] 4B), as a validated PNG/JPEG with provenance (engine, model, licence). Never decides what to show and never composes: the result is an ordinary image asset for thumbnail/render. Refused (TOOL_ERROR, reason provider_unavailable) when the provider is not configured or cannot run.

output.provenance: object (generated, provider, engine, model, licence, prompt, seed, steps, guidance_scale)

tools.requires: a configured background provider (see background_providers); never downloads a model, opens no connection

dependencies.uses: video.text_regions (text legibility, its ADR-018) on a written thumbnail

assets.video_frame: explicit timestamp only; this skill never searches for a 'best frame'

elements.stacking: z_index, ties broken by document order

image.description: A still image or an extracted video frame, placed and sized on the canvas.

text.description: Literal text (explicit '\n' for line breaks; no automatic word-wrap or layout decisions).

platform_presets.precedence: explicit document.canvas width+height win over the preset's size; with a preset both may be omitted (the preset's size is used); giving only one of the two is INVALID_REQUEST. The preset's limits are checked either way.
platform_presets.check: after rendering, the written artifact's real dimensions (min/max width/height and aspect-ratio range), format and byte size are checked against the preset before it is cached or placed at the output path; a cache hit is checked the same way
platform_presets.response: on success, `preset` {name, platform, checked, ok} in the response and `preset` (name) in provenance; absent without a preset
platform_presets.bytes: max_bytes in bytes, decimal megabytes (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes)

placeholders.values: inserted literally, never re-scanned; relative asset paths resolve against the workspace, as in thumbnail/render

csv.encoding_note: utf-8 accepts a leading byte-order mark; cp932 is the opt-in choice for a CSV saved by Japanese Excel

batch.targets: one per output.preset; the template's canvas may omit width/height (the preset's size is used); 16:9 and 9:16 are two targets (for example youtube and youtube-shorts), each with its own layout

text_fit.rule: the largest font size from the template's own size down to min_font_size at which the element's painted box (layout block, background, ink with stroke and shadow) fits max_width x max_height and lies inside the canvas
text_fit.does_not_fit: VALIDATION_ERROR (reason text_does_not_fit), before anything is written

batch.order: every row and target is planned and checked first (structure, placeholders, fonts, text fit, input files, output names); then each is rendered with thumbnail/render; a failure while rendering stops the batch and lists the files already written (details.written)

inputs.faces: detection-skill/detections@1 from detection-skill (detection faces --attributes): boxes, eyes_open, frontal, size, sharpness
inputs.frame_measures: caller-supplied [{t, sharpness, mean_luma}]; media-analysis-skill does not publish frame sharpness or exposure yet

score.order: eyes open first, then score, then input order

placement.text_box: layout block, background and ink with stroke and shadow (renderer.text_box)
placement.face_mapping: through the image element's crop, fit (cover, contain, fill, none) and position; rotation 0 only
placement.none_clear: VALIDATION_ERROR (reason no_position_clear_of_faces), every tried position listed

axes.layout: the text element's position and alignment (and font_size when an entry gives one); default: eight edge and corner positions
axes.palette: the text element's colour, background band and stroke; default: white-on-dark-band, black-on-yellow-band, white-with-outline
axes.frame: the asset one image element shows (variants.frames + variants.frame_element); default: none

variants.rule: variant k takes entry (k-1) mod n of each axis; entry 0 of each axis is the document as given ('as-given'), so variant 1 is the original
variants.files: <output stem>-v<k><ext> beside output.path; output.preset is checked on every variant

small_size_check.text_height: per text element: the tallest run of pixel rows containing its own glyph ink (fill only, alpha >= 128), drawn alone with the renderer's layout, times phone_width / canvas width
small_size_check.min_text_height_note: this skill's default floor at phone_width, a heuristic, not a platform figure
small_size_check.contrast: qc-skill video.text_regions on the written variant at the element's painted box (WCAG 2.x contrast ratio, qc-skill ADR-018)
small_size_check.without_qc_skill: contrast_unmeasured (status unknown) and a warning; the height check still runs
small_size_check.below_a_minimum: reported: small_size.status fail, findings text_too_small / low_contrast, the variant listed in flagged; never dropped

layered_output.layers: layer 0 is the canvas background (full canvas); then, in stacking order, each image element as pasted (after crop, fit, rotation, opacity) and each text element's background band and text (after opacity), each cropped to its visible pixels; a composite with no visible pixel is listed with file null
layered_output.compose: start from layer 0 (the background, the full canvas) as the base image; then alpha-composite every further layer at its position, in order (Porter-Duff source-over on straight 8-bit RGBA, as Pillow's Image.alpha_composite)
layered_output.verified: the image rebuilt from the layer files read back from disk equals the written PNG byte for byte (for a JPEG thumbnail: the lossless composite it was encoded from); otherwise VALIDATION_ERROR (reason layers_mismatch)

background_providers.without_a_provider: render, extract_frame and validate are unchanged; doctor reports the provider not_configured without changing its status; generate_background is refused (TOOL_ERROR, reason provider_unavailable, not retryable)
background_providers.configured_but_unavailable: doctor status degraded (a warning names what is missing); generate_background refused the same way

fonts.resolution: font_id -> the first existing file among this skill's registered per-platform candidate paths (fonts.py); never an arbitrary caller-supplied path; a font_id with no resolvable file fails MISSING_INPUT, never a silent substitution

rendering.video_frame_decoding: delegated to ffmpeg-skill (probe, look --at --no-timecode); this skill never runs ffmpeg itself
rendering.compositing: Pillow raster operations only (paste/crop/resize/draw); no filter string, no shell, no arbitrary code path

execution.stdout: exactly one thumbnail-skill/response@1 document (through run -) or {'ok', 'tool', 'result'}

ffmpeg_skill.compatibility: any version whose probe/look expose flags_required (detected from its contract or --help; no version window)

provenance.identity: sha256 over canonical JSON of {document, resolved asset content identity, resolved font content identity, skill/engine version}; a video_frame's identity is its source video's sha256 + timestamp, not the decoded frame's bytes
